governingRules: The Himachal Pradesh District Judiciary Staff (Recruitment, Promotion, Control, Conduct, Discipline and Other Conditions of Service) Rules, 2022
minimumQualification: 10+2 standard or equivalent from a recognized Board/University
ageLimit: 18 to 45 years (relaxation for SC/ST/OBC/Ex-Servicemen as per State Govt rules)

stages.name: Screening Test (Objective MCQs)
stages.negativeMarking: No negative marking officially prescribed in Rules 2022
stages.shortlistingRatio: 1:5 (5 candidates per advertised vacancy qualified for written test)
stages.purpose: Qualifying / Shortlisting filter only. Marks not added to final merit.

sections.name: Himachal Pradesh General Knowledge
topics: HP Geography (Rivers, Lakes, Glaciers, Mountain Passes, Valleys)
HP History (Ancient tribes, princely states, Praja Mandal movement, Statehood)
Districts of HP (Headquarters, demographic census 2011, boundaries)
Culture & Heritage (Fairs, festivals, folk dances, temples, languages/dialects)
Economy & Hydroelectric Power (Hydel projects, agriculture, horticulture, tourism)

sections.name: General Knowledge & Everyday Science
topics: Indian Polity & Constitution (Fundamental Rights, Judiciary, Parliament)
Everyday Science (General physics, chemistry, human body, vitamins, environmental issues)
Important National Days, Books & Authors, Awards

sections.name: Mathematics (10+2 Standard)
topics: Time and Work, Speed, Distance & Time

sections.name: General Hindi
topics: अनेक शब्दों के लिए एक शब्द
कारक, लिंग, वचन एवं वाक्य शुद्धि

stages.name: Written Test (Descriptive)
stages.purpose: Core component of Final Selection Merit (40 out of 50 marks)

sections.name: Hindi Essay Writing (निबंध लेखन)
sections.format: Candidates choose one out of three given contemporary/regional topics.
sections.keyEvaluationFactors: Relevance to topic, logical flow, grammatical purity, vocabulary, and clean legible handwriting.

sections.name: English Application / Letter Writing
sections.format: Formal official application or letter (e.g., to the District & Sessions Judge, administrative officer, or local authority).
sections.keyEvaluationFactors: Proper layout/format (Sender, Date, Receiver, Subject, Salutation, Body, Sign-off), clarity, grammatical correctness, and handwriting.

stages.name: Evaluation / Interview
stages.purpose: Final assessment added to Written Test score (40 + 10 = 50 total merit)

components.name: Educational Qualification
components.criteria: 10+2 Pass = 1 Mark; 10+2 with First Division = 2 Marks; Any Bachelor's Degree or higher = 3 Marks

components.name: Experience
components.criteria: Relevant service in Government/Semi-Government offices or Subordinate Courts

components.name: Interview / Viva-Voce
components.criteria: Personal interview testing communication, alertness, and suitability for judicial court process duties
